title: 按钮交换两灯
subtitle: 每按一次交换亮灭；第二轮增量改为长按 2 秒才切换

turns.prompt: 给两个灯增加一个按钮。每按一次按钮，交换两个灯的亮灭状态。
turns.summary:
项目目前是空的，所以我先建好了两个 LED，再加上按钮。灯1（红）接 GPIO4（经 220 Ω 限流电阻到 GND），灯2（绿）接 GPIO5（经 220 Ω 到 GND），按钮一端接 GPIO6、另一端接 GND，固件里启用内部上拉（按下 = 低电平）。上电后初始状态为「灯1 亮 / 灯2 灭」；固件每 10 ms 轮询按钮，只在按下那一刻（高→低边沿）执行一次交换：把两个灯的状态变量对调并输出到引脚。因此按第 1 次 → 灯1 灭 / 灯2 亮，按第 2 次 → 恢复灯1 亮 / 灯2 灭，按住不放不会重复触发。验证场景在 1.0 s 与 2.0 s 各按一次（每次 200 ms 后松开），并逐段检查两次按压前后的亮灭状态以及整个过程中的翻转次数（每个灯恰好 2 次），全部用电路求解器测到的真实 LED 通断来判定。

plan.understanding: The project is currently EMPTY (no parts, no logic — only the starter main.c), so despite the wording "add a button to the two LEDs", the two LEDs must be created too. Target behaviour: two LEDs (LED1 red on GPIO4, LED2 green on GPIO5) with a momentary push button on GPIO6 (internal pull-up, pressed = LOW). At startup LED1 = ON and LED2 = OFF. Every valid button press exchanges the two states: LED1 = old LED2 state, LED2 = old LED1 state (so press 1 → LED1 off / LED2 on, press 2 → back to LED1 on / LED2 off). One action per press (edge-triggered, no auto-repeat while held). Button polling every 10 ms with a short debounce; the press at t = 1000/2000 ms is thus acted upon within ~10–20 ms.

pin_plan.notes: Push-pull output; HIGH lights led1 (active-high through r1)
Push-pull output; HIGH lights led2 (active-high through r2)
gpiO_config with GPIO_PULLUP_ONLY; button to GND → pressed = level 0, released = level 1

wiring.purpose: GPIO4 drives led1 branch through r1
GPIO5 drives led2 branch through r2
GPIO6 senses the button; internal pull-up keeps it HIGH when open
Button other terminal to ground (pressed pulls GPIO6 LOW)

plan.firmware_plan:
main/main.c (ESP-IDF v5.5, plain C, app_main entry):
1) Startup: set both GPIOs as outputs (gpio_config with GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT for GPIO_NUM_4 and GPIO_NUM_5, no pulls).
2) Set button pin GPIO_NUM_6 as GPIO_MODE_INPUT with GPIO_PULLUP_ONLY (polling, no interrupts — most robust in the simulator).
3) Initial lamp state: led1_state = 1, led2_state = 0; apply immediately with gpio_set_level(GPIO_NUM_4, led1_state); gpio_set_level(GPIO_NUM_5, led2_state); (first write lands ≈12–14 ms after reset). printf initial state line.
4) Main polling loop (no blocking waits, ends with vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)) so the task watchdog is fed):
   - raw = gpio_get_level(GPIO_NUM_6);
   - Debounce/edge detection: keep prev_raw; a press event = (raw == 0 && prev_raw == 1). Because the trigger is the HIGH→LOW edge only, holding the button produces no repeats and the action fires once per press. (Optional 2-sample confirmation: require raw == 0 twice, i.e. ~20 ms stable — still ≪ the 200 ms stimulus press length.)
   - On a press event: uint8_t tmp = led1_state; led1_state = led2_state; led2_state = tmp; then gpio_set_level(GPIO_NUM_4, led1_state); gpio_set_level(GPIO_NUM_5, led2_state); and printf("SWAP: led1=%d led2=%d\n", led1_state, led2_state).
   - prev_raw = raw; vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)).
5) Resulting timeline: states are always complementary starting (ON, OFF). Press at 1000 ms → (OFF, ON) applied ≈1010–1020 ms; release at 1200 ms → no change; press at 2000 ms → back to (ON, OFF) applied ≈2010–2020 ms; release at 2200 ms → no change. No long blocking loops, no PWM, no unsupported peripherals.

turns.prompt: 现在改成按住超过两秒才切换。
turns.summary:
电路完全不变（LED1 红—GPIO4、LED2 绿—GPIO5、按钮—GPIO6 + 内部上拉，各经 220 Ω 到 GND），只改固件：不再一按下就交换，而是必须「持续按住超过 2 秒」才交换一次。固件每 10 ms 轮询按钮，按下确认后开始计时（esp_timer），按住时长达到 2000 ms 时把两个灯的状态对调并锁定，直到松开才重新武装；按住不足 2 秒抬起不产生任何动作，按住不放也不会重复交换。上电初始仍为灯1 亮 / 灯2 灭。验证场景：先 0.5 s 与 1.5 s 两次短按（应无变化，灯1 保持亮），再按住 2.9 s（灯1 变灭 / 灯2 变亮），再按住 3.0 s（交换回来），全程用电路求解器实测的两个 LED 通断判定，并检查每个灯在整个过程中恰好翻转 2 次。

虚拟验证通过 (virtual simulation verification passed — not physical hardware):
✓ led1 stayed on from 1200 to 4400 ms
✓ led2 stayed off from 1200 to 4400 ms
✓ led1 stayed on from 4900 to 6400 ms
✓ led2 stayed off from 4900 to 6400 ms
✓ led1 stayed off from 7000 to 9000 ms
✓ led2 stayed on from 7000 to 9000 ms
✓ led1 stayed on from 12000 to 13300 ms
✓ led2 stayed off from 12000 to 13300 ms
✓ led1 toggled 2 time(s) in 50–13400 ms (expected 2–2)
✓ led2 toggled 2 time(s) in 50–13400 ms (expected 2–2)
✓ UART output contains "SWAP" (log evidence only — not a physical signal)

plan.understanding: 电路保持不变（LED1 红—GPIO4 经 220 Ω 到 GND，LED2 绿—GPIO5 经 220 Ω 到 GND，按钮—GPIO6 到 GND 并用内部上拉）。只改固件行为：不再「按下即交换」，而是必须「按住超过 2 秒」才交换一次——按下后持续检测，按住时长达到 2000 ms 时执行一次交换并锁定，直到松开按钮才重新武装；按住不足 2 秒（例如 0.5 s / 1.5 s）抬起则不发生任何交换。上电初始状态仍为 LED1 亮 / LED2 灭，每次成功的长按交换两个灯的亮灭。

plan.firmware_plan:
保持现有 GPIO 配置（GPIO4/GPIO5 推挽输出，GPIO6 输入 + 内部上拉）与初始状态（led1_state=1 亮, led2_state=0 灭），仅把「边沿触发」改成「长按 2 秒触发」：

1) 常量：POLL_MS=10、DEBOUNCE_CNT=2（连续 2 次低电平 ≈20 ms 视为稳定按下）、HOLD_US=2000000（2 秒）。
2) app_main 进入 while(1) 轮询循环：raw = gpio_get_level(GPIO_NUM_6)。
3) raw==0（按住）：low_cnt++；当 low_cnt>=DEBOUNCE_CNT（按下已确认）时，如果 press_us 尚未记录（press_us==0），用 esp_timer_get_time() 记录按下起点；然后每次循环计算 hold_us = esp_timer_get_time() - press_us；若 hold_us >= 2000000 且 !fired，则执行一次交换（led1_state/led2_state 互换并 gpio_set_level 输出到 GPIO4/GPIO5），置 fired=1，打印 "SWAP (hold=... ms): led1=.. led2=.."。fired=1 后只要还按着就不再重复交换。
4) raw!=0（松开/未按）：low_cnt=0; press_us=0; fired=0;（松开即复位长按计时并重新武装；短于 2 s 的按压不会发生交换）。
5) 循环末尾 vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(POLL_MS)) 喂看门狗，app_main 永不返回。

预期时序（t=0 为复位，app_main 约 12–14 ms）：初始 LED1 亮/LED2 灭；按下 2 s 后（含约 20 ms 去抖）才在 GPIO 上产生一次翻转，翻转到来的时间 ≈ 按下时刻 + 2020 ms。松开后再长按 2 s 会再次交换。
